title: Higgsfield raises $400 million Series B at $5.4 billion valuation
excerpt: The AI video platform said its annualized revenue reached $700 million this month, up from $20 million a year earlier
content_html:
Higgsfield announced a $400 million Series B financing round on Monday at a $5.4 billion valuation, more than quadrupling its $1.3 billion valuation from its Series A funding round. DST Global led the round, with participation from Tribe Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Smash Capital, Fifth Wall, Valor Capital, Intel Capital, Liberty Global Tech Ventures, Mirae Asset Capital, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, the company said. Existing investors including Accel, Menlo Ventures, and GFT Ventures also participated.

Higgsfield said its annualized revenue reached $700 million this month, up from $20 million a year earlier, according to Yahoo Finance. Business customers now account for the majority of that revenue — a reversal from January, when they represented less than one-quarter of sales, the company said.

The company said it now serves more than 30 million users across 238 countries and territories and powers visual production for 390 of the Fortune 500. Its enterprise customer base spans advertising, media and entertainment, broadcasting, fashion, retail, financial services, and pharmaceuticals, the company said.

Higgsfield co-founder and CEO Alex Mashrabov verified the deal's details in a conversation with the Financial Times, according to Yahoo Finance. "At Snapchat, the face filters I built were primarily used by teenagers for entertainment. At Higgsfield, we are transforming how larger businesses run marketing campaigns," Mashrabov said.

Alex Mashrabov, who had earlier co-founded AI Factory — the computer vision firm whose technology powers Snapchat's face filters — launched Higgsfield alongside his fellow co-founders. Snap acquired AI Factory in 2019, the company said.

A key driver of Higgsfield's growth has been adoption of its agentic products, which automate multi-scene visual production, the company said. Following a Supercomputer rollout in May 2026, users of those products grew 42-fold in three months, driving more than 20 million content generations per month.

The company said it plans to use the proceeds to fund research and development, expand global infrastructure, hire AI talent, and scale its sales operations.

DST Global founder Yuri Milner said in a statement that the firm looks forward to supporting the team "as they build the next generation of AI tools for visual creation."

content_html_zh:
Higgsfield 周一宣布进行 4 亿美元的 B 轮融资，估值为 54 亿美元，是 A 轮融资 13 亿美元估值的四倍多。 该公司表示，本轮融资由 DST Global 领投，Tribe Capital、Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives、Smash Capital、Fifth Wall、Valor Capital、Intel Capital、Liberty Global Tech Ventures、Mirae Asset Capital 和 NTT DOCOMO Ventures 参与。 Accel、Menlo Ventures 和 GFT Ventures 等现有投资者也参与其中。

据雅虎财经报道，Higgsfield 表示，本月其年化收入达到 7 亿美元，高于去年同期的 2000 万美元。 该公司表示，企业客户现在占收入的大部分，与 1 月份的情况相反，当时企业客户仅占销售额的不到四分之一。

该公司表示，目前为 238 个国家和地区的超过 3000 万用户提供服务，并为《财富》500 强中的 390 家公司提供视觉制作。 该公司表示，其企业客户群涵盖广告、媒体和娱乐、广播、时尚、零售、金融服务和制药。

据雅虎财经报道，Higgsfield 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Alex Mashrabov 在与英国《金融时报》的对话中证实了该交易的细节。 “在 Snapchat，我制作的面部滤镜主要供青少年用于娱乐。 在希格斯菲尔德，我们正在改变大型企业开展营销活动的方式，”马什拉博夫说。

亚历克斯·马什拉博夫 (Alex Mashrabov) 曾是 AI Factory（一家计算机视觉公司，其技术为 Snapchat 的面部滤镜提供支持）的联合创始人，他与其他联合创始人一起创立了 Higgsfield。 该公司表示，Snap 于 2019 年收购了 AI Factory。

该公司表示，希格斯菲尔德增长的一个关键驱动力是其代理产品的采用，这些产品可以实现多场景视觉制作的自动化。 超级计算机于 2026 年 5 月推出后，这些产品的用户在三个月内增长了 42 倍，每月生成超过 2000 万个内容。

该公司表示，计划将所得资金用于资助研发、扩大全球基础设施、雇用人工智能人才以及扩大销售业务。

DST Global 创始人尤里·米尔纳 (Yuri Milner) 在一份声明中表示，该公司期待支持该团队“打造下一代视觉创作人工智能工具”。
